title: Stop ruining your cast iron pan (Part 1)
hook: Never use soap on cast iron.

script.narration: Never use soap on cast iron.
script.visual_search: dirty cast iron skillet in kitchen sink

script.narration: Old dish soap contained harsh lye that stripped the essential seasoning right off the metal. Today's mild dish soap is actually completely safe to use when cleaning.
script.visual_search: adding drops of dish soap to a sponge

script.narration: Do you still use soap on yours? Comment yes or no.
script.visual_search: close up of person washing cast iron pan

script.narration: Follow so you don't miss Part 2 on how to completely restore a rusted skillet!

description:
Stop ruining your cookware with outdated advice. Learn the surprising truth about washing cast iron skillets safely without destroying your seasoning.

Subscribe for more quick life hacks.
tags: how to clean a cast iron skillet
why_it_will_work: Targets high-volume search intent around cleaning cast iron while combining a myth-busting format with a two-part series cliffhanger.
